name: ultrasuite-benchmark
description:
UltraSuite
	

UltraSuite is a collection of ultrasound tongue imaging and acoustic speech data recorded during speech therapy sessions.

	
		
		License
	

UltraSuite datasets are released under the Creative Commons Attribution–NonCommercial 4.0 International (CC BY-NC 4.0) license.

	
		
		Citation
	

Eshky, A., Ribeiro, M. S., Cleland, J., Richmond, K., Roxburgh, Z., Scobbie, J., & Wrench, A. (2018) Ultrasuite: A repository of ultrasound and acoustic data from child speech therapy… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/changelinglab/ultrasuite-benchmark.
evaluation_method: task-dependent (e.g., WER for ASR, MAE/RMSE or correlation for articulatory prediction, human_eval for perceptual tasks)
general_score_metric: task-dependent (commonly WER for ASR tasks or MAE/RMSE for articulatory prediction)
reputation: Moderately adopted in the speech and articulatory phonetics research communities as a standard multimodal dataset for ultrasound-to-acoustic and articulatory studies.
